endingNote.note: line 23 is unanswered — hold 1.5s then cut to black, nothing after

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: I graduated top of my class. I'm twenty-four. I still ask my dad for rent money.
lines.delivery: Quiet confession, not a complaint. He is not performing, he is admitting.
lines.scene: Human alone, small in frame, dim. Byte is not on screen yet — just a faint teal glow from above.
lines.camera: Close on Human, slightly low angle so he looks small
lines.purpose: Hook frame. No AI gimmick yet — just a person at the bottom. Scroll stops on the face, not the robot.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: How many applications?
lines.delivery: Gentle question, no judgement

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: A hundred and forty. Three replies. One was a scam.
lines.delivery: Flat recital, he has said this before
lines.scene: 140 application cards fall past the frame like rain, top to bottom. Three catch mid-air and burn out.
lines.purpose: Vertical format's gift: falling objects read beautifully. Makes the number physical.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: ...Okay.
lines.delivery: Just taking it in. Not a lead-in to advice.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: I did everything they told me to do. Everything. So why does it feel like I wasted four years?
lines.delivery: Starts controlled, breaks on the last question
lines.scene: A graduation cap sits on the floor beside him. He doesn't look at it.
lines.purpose: The emotional low. Hold here — this is where the viewer decides to stay.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: You didn't waste them. You just believed something that isn't true.
lines.delivery: Firm reassurance first, then the turn

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: What?
lines.delivery: Small, genuine

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: That the degree was the finish line.
lines.delivery: Landed softly, not triumphantly

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: ...Wasn't it?
lines.delivery: Small voice

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: It's the starting line. And two thousand people are standing on it right next to you.
lines.delivery: Clear, slightly ominous on the second half
lines.scene: Camera pulls up and back. A start line glows under Human, and the frame fills with thousands of identical silhouettes stretching up the vertical.
lines.purpose: The one big-scale shot. Vertical makes the crowd stack upward, which looks more crushing than sideways.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: So what makes anyone pick me?
lines.delivery: Real question, not rhetorical

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Would you hire someone who's only read about driving?
lines.delivery: Question as answer, light but pointed
lines.scene: A book and a steering wheel spin into frame between them.
lines.purpose: The single joke. Keeps it from being relentlessly heavy.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: That's not fair. Nobody will let me drive!
lines.delivery: Snaps back, loud
lines.scene: On 13 the room flares red and shakes. On 14 everything goes still and the light softens to warm.
lines.gesture: Human throws an arm out, then drops it
lines.camera: Hard cut on 13, then locked still frame on 14
lines.purpose: **The most important beat.** The visual stops fighting him at exactly the moment the AI stops arguing.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: I know. That part is real. It's not in your head, and you didn't cause it.
lines.delivery: Slow, deliberate. The most important delivery in the video.
lines.scene: On 13 the room flares red and shakes. On 14 everything goes still and the light softens to warm.
lines.gesture: Human throws an arm out, then drops it
lines.camera: Hard cut on 13, then locked still frame on 14
lines.purpose: **The most important beat.** The visual stops fighting him at exactly the moment the AI stops arguing.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Then what do I do?
lines.delivery: Surrender. He stops fighting here.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Hiring is a bet. Right now, you're a question mark.
lines.delivery: Plain explanation
lines.scene: Human's silhouette becomes a glowing question mark, seen from an employer's POV looking down.
lines.gesture: Looks down at his own body
lines.purpose: Makes "hiring risk" something you can see in one frame.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Your degree says you could do the job. It doesn't say you have.
lines.delivery: The core line. Clean contrast on could and have.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: I can't prove it without a job.
lines.delivery: The trap, stated plainly

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Who said proof only comes from a job?
lines.delivery: Light, the first hopeful beat

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: One real thing. Built for one real person. That turns 'trust me' into 'look at this.'
lines.delivery: The guidance. Slow and clear — this is what they screenshot.
lines.scene: A speech bubble reading "trust me" cracks and reforms as "look at this", with a small glowing project card inside it.
lines.camera: Close-up on the bubble, fills the vertical frame
lines.purpose: **The screenshot frame.** This is the one people save and repost. Make it the cleanest shot in the video.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: ...That's the difference?
lines.delivery: Barely above a whisper
lines.scene: Light shifts from cold blue to warm amber across Human's face.
lines.gesture: Head lifts for the first time
lines.purpose: The turn, shown with colour instead of dialogue.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Your degree gets you read. Your proof gets you hired.
lines.delivery: The line they repost. Clean, even, no rush.
lines.scene: Two lines of text stack centre-frame: "Degree → gets you read" above, "Proof → gets you hired" below.
lines.purpose: Thumbnail, repost frame and the line people quote in comments.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: So. What can you show me?
lines.delivery: Direct to camera energy. This is aimed at the viewer, not the Human.
lines.scene: Byte turns to face camera directly. Human is out of focus behind.
lines.camera: Push-in on Byte, hold 1.5s, cut to black
lines.purpose: Breaks the fourth wall on the last line so the question lands on the viewer. Drives comments.
